plus_ps_check_compat.name: plus_update_check_enabled
plus_ps_check_compat.label: Tell me when a new Charis Viewer is out (checked at start, once a day)
plus_ps_check_compat.tool_tip: On by default. Reads one small file from the update site (setting PlusUpdateCheckURL, a file on GitHub by default; nothing is read while it is empty) at most once a day, at start, and tells of a newer version at the login screen. As with any web page, the site keeps your IP address and the viewer's version in its log. Nothing about your account or avatar is sent. Off: nothing is read or shown.

plus_ps_combo.name: plus_update_install
plus_ps_combo.tool_tip: For the viewer installed with Setup.exe. A new version is found by the check above; what then: only tell (as the zip: the button opens the download page), ask first (the default: nothing is downloaded until you press Download), or download it without asking. Either way it is put in only when you quit the viewer or press Restart and update.

plus_ps_combo.item.name: install_only_tell
plus_ps_combo.item.label: Only tell me (the button opens the download page)

plus_ps_combo.item.name: install_ask
plus_ps_combo.item.label: Ask me before downloading a new version

plus_ps_combo.item.name: install_automatic
plus_ps_combo.item.label: Download a new version without asking; put it in when I quit
